6. Assumption: skip edges are harmless and universally helpful. Negation: a skip that duplicates features already sent through a conv path interferes.
7. Assumption: the direct edge 3 is independent of the multi-hop branches. Negation: it substitutes for or enables them.
8. Assumption: the effect of an edit depends on its own edge and its feeder. Negation: it depends on the sibling route into the same node.
